snippet.title: Ardhan - Roguelike Deckbuilder Trailer | Free on Android and PC
snippet.description:
Ardhan is a roguelike deckbuilder: build a deck, walk the road across a broken world, and fight board battles with minions, spells and hero powers. 12 factions, 8 bosses, illustrated events, rest camps with a story for every act, the Caravan, a Rival who hunts you, Relic-Buffs, Trials and a deck builder that can fill your deck for you. Narrated in nine languages.

Play free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391500/
Also free on the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ8P3417S5?cid=vid90_en
Ardhan is now out on Android too! Search "Ardhan" on Google Play. Also free on Steam and the Microsoft Store.
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unitechdigital.ardhan&referrer=utm_source%3Dexp_yt_en%26utm_medium%3Dpost
